typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	HEALTHLINK_DATASOURCE as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_DB as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_PWD as string (),
	HEALTHLINK_USER as string (),
	v_createUserID as integer (),
	v_fileExists as boolean (),
	v_log_EventDate as string (),
	v_outreachFileFolder as string (),
	v_outreachFileName as string (),
	v_processedFileFolder as string ()
}

source(output(
		ContactSource as string,
		TopicsCovered as string,
		SubscriberID as string,
		Remarks as string,
		LoadDate as timestamp,
		ContactDate as timestamp,
		Notes as string,
		ContactSourceType as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'select * from [member].[PHLOutreachErrorOutRecords]',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OLEDBSource
OLEDBSource sink(input(
		Contact_Source as string,
		Topics_Covered as string,
		Subscriber_ID as string,
		Remarks as string,
		CreateDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Contact_Date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		Notes as string,
		Contact_Source_Type as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		Contact_Source = ContactSource,
		Topics_Covered = TopicsCovered,
		Subscriber_ID = SubscriberID,
		Remarks,
		CreateDate = LoadDate,
		Contact_Date = ContactDate,
		Notes,
		Contact_Source_Type = ContactSourceType)) ~> FlatFileDestination
